== Story 636: English errata source audit ==
Compared the actual English original/later faces and primary replacement paragraphs. [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement]], updated 29 January 2002, p. 6. [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, edition dated 30 July 2023, p. 122. The actual Dark Side original and later faces were inspected separately from their Light Side counterparts. The Supplement p. 6 makes attacking a present starfighter mandatory; Appendix A p. 122 later supplies the parasite and random-detachment restrictions. No matching full face was located for the intermediate. The comparison preserves complete clauses; following ruling paragraphs and attributes supplied only by rules are not inserted into printed Game Text. All observed statistics and uniqueness remain unchanged. Canonical titles, article corrections, documentary states and Versions changes are coordinated with Story 617; this packet proposes shared-table transclusions only. --~~~~
